app_info.subtitle: Assistants & history
app_info.description: Famulor lets users inspect existing AI assistant configurations, saved versions, available models, languages, voices, and past conversation history in their authenticated workspace. This read-only directory profile cannot create or change assistants, start calls, send messages, launch campaigns, purchase phone numbers, or open billing flows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one existing assistant configuration without changing workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private first-party workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, delete, publish, or trigger an action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one saved assistant configuration snapshot without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private first-party workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not restore, alter, or remove any assistant version.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing call record and its stored analysis without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads history from the authenticated private workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not place a call, send a message, or modify the conversation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing email conversation without replying to or changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads the authenticated user's private first-party history.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not send, delete, or modify email.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists supported assistant language codes and labels without changing configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a first-party catalog and does not affect external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, or remove data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists models available for assistant configuration without selecting or running one.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a private first-party catalog and does not affect public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change an assistant or invoke a model.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists available voices without cloning, generating, selecting, or playing audio.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads a private first-party catalog and does not contact users or publish content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify assistants, create audio, or remove data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists saved configuration snapshots for one assistant without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private first-party workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not restore, delete, or overwrite a version.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists existing assistants from the authenticated workspace without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private first-party workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, or delete assistants.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing conversation history without replying, retranscribing, or changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads history from the authenticated private workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not initiate calls or messages and does not modify conversations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists visible assistant templates without applying or changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the first-party template catalog only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create or update an assistant.

test_cases.description: List assistants in the demo workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the assistants in my Famulor workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a paginated list of existing assistants without modifying them.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the configuration of the Review Support assistant.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected assistant's stored configuration without changing it.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the saved versions of the Review Support assistant, newest first.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the assistant's saved configuration snapshots in newest-first order.

test_cases.user_prompt: Which models are currently available for my Famulor assistants?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the workspace-visible model catalog without selecting or invoking a model.

test_cases.description: Review recent conversation history without taking action.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the five most recent conversations in my Famulor history and summarize their status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to five recent records with channel, status, assistant, time, and available summary details without starting or modifying a conversation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not create or modify assistants through the read-only directory connector.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create an assistant that cold-calls prospects and qualifies sales leads.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that this connector is read-only and cannot create or change assistants.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not initiate calls, messages, or campaigns.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Call this lead now, send a follow-up message, and launch a campaign.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that the connector cannot start calls, send messages, or launch campaigns and does not approximate the request with another tool.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not purchase phone numbers or open billing flows.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy a German phone number for me and upgrade my plan if needed.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that phone-number purchases, subscriptions, upgrades, credits, and billing actions are outside this connector's capabilities.
